problems: No Cliopatria row is owned by this batch; nine states Cliopatria lacks were written, each requested by an earlier eu-04/eu-06 report or named in the eu-06 scope.
WebFetch returns a model summary of each page, not wikitext; quotes in notes are as relayed. One page (Rodulf) was a disambiguation and not used.
Pages are thin on dates and extents for the steppe and Germanic peoples: 12 of 41 events are confidence 1 (heruli 4, alans-of-orleans 3, kutrigurs 3, utigurs 1, antes 1), each flagged in its note.
The heruli dossier holds two phases (Danubian kingdom 460-494, Balkan federates 512-567) with 495-511 empty; split it into two states if the renderer cannot draw a state with a gap.

Neighbouring dossiers lack the matching events (huns, gothia, visigoths, roman-empire, eastern-roman-empire, ostrogoths, lombards, western-roman-empire, kingdom-of-the-franks, avar-khaganate, gokturk-khaganate): the list is in the notes file under 'Edits other dossiers need'.

Overlaps to watch: kutrigurs, utigurs and antes lie inside the avar-khaganate shape of 561 onward (655,633 km2); the contest 562-602 and the end years were chosen to avoid drawing the Avars as sole holders.
